name: @forgeax/game-marscraft
description: MarsCraft — a StarCraft-style 3D RTS, ported from a Three.js implementation to the forgeax-engine (WebGPU ECS). Mars terrain, RTS camera, selectable/commandable units, economy, combat, buildings. Loaded by apps/preview via loadGame dynamic import.

bundle-size.reason: sample game bundle is downstream of the host app (apps/preview)

fps.reason: sample game has no independent smoke gate

bench.reason: sample game; bench focus stays on engine packages

gate.reason: no CI gate on sample games; apps/preview hosts acceptance
